instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an outdoor scene next to a light-brown tiled wall with a street lamp visible in the background. On the left, the man with dreadlocks in a yellow jersey (R2) stands leaning forward with both hands pressed flat against the wall. Behind him on the right, the bald security guard in a dark uniform (R1) leans in, placing his right hand on the lower back of the man (R2) during a pat-down. The guard looks down at the man's waist. The image is lit by bright, warm daylight, creating soft natural shadows.
